author: Donna Ridge Ingle
text: I had a fall off, so I called.  It became obvious I was going to have to wait a long time, so I did an online request.  Never heard anything back, so I called and waited 30 mins for someone.  They told me they were sorry, and that my order was in process but had not shipped, and they would expedite the process.  3 days later I had seen no proof nor tracking number.  Called again and waited another 30 mins for a real person and was told my order was showing as shipped, but they could not provide a delivery date or a tracking number.  They said they would do another request for me, and that I would now be getting 2 sensors, and the second one would be a "gift".  That was on Dec 26, and I have still not received either of them.  Most likely will call them again tomorrow.  At first, customer service was wonderful, but now, it really sucks.  So frustrating...
